LESSON: CARE OF TOILETS/ LATRINES 1.0 HEALTH

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.8: Care of toilets/ latrines 1.0 Health

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Care of toilets/ latrines 1.0 Health. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the materials used pictures or realia. in cleaning a toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment, video clips. 199
2. explains the procedure of cleaning a toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment
3. appreciate the need for a clean toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment. Core-Competence to be developed Critical thinking, Problem solving

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the materials used pictures or realia. in cleaning a toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment, video clips. 199
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the materials used pictures or realia. in cleaning a toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment, video clips. 199. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. explains the procedure of cleaning a toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to explains the procedure of cleaning a toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the need for a clean toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment. Core-Competence to be developed Critical thinking, Problem solving
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the need for a clean toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment. Core-Competence to be developed Critical thinking, Problem solving. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Care of toilets/ latrines 1.0 Health.
2. Explain Care of toilets/ latrines 1.0 Health to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Care of toilets/ latrines 1.0 Health.
4. Show that you can: identify the materials used pictures or realia. in cleaning a toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment, video clips. 199
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Care of toilets/ latrines 1.0 Health. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Care of toilets/ latrines 1.0 Health important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify the materials used pictures or realia. in cleaning a toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment, video clips. 199
2. explains the procedure of cleaning a toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment
3. appreciate the need for a clean toilet, latrine or urinal in their environment. Core-Competence to be developed Critical thinking, Problem solving

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
